method: Fact Recall: complete target cell or all required prose phrases in the top five child slices. Cell labels are bound to verified original-page state rows and complete header paths, not value substrings. Blank facts require the whole row slice. Binary child relevance requires one complete target cell or required prose phrase; generic header-only chunks are irrelevant. Precision denominator is five even with fewer candidates; MRR cutoff five; binary NDCG uses all frozen one-file children for IDCG. Candidate metrics exclude expansion/header supplements. Final structural coverage separately checks actual supplied exact text, cell tuples, row and header context; blank proof additionally requires the entire original row. Single Codex semantic review remains separate; no independent second review was performed for answer/evidence quality.
